name: scrcpy
description_en: Display and control your Android device
readme_excerpt: > [!WARNING] > This GitHub repo ( ) is the only official source for the project. Do not download releases from random websites, even if their name contains scrcpy. scrcpy (v4.1) pronounced "screen copy" This application mirrors Android devices (video and audio) connected via USB or TCP/IP and allows control using the computer's keyboard and mouse.
